references.text: Jesus teaches about the power of faith and that everything asked for in faith will be received, paralleling the idea in Mark 9:23 that with faith all things are possible.
The angel's words to Mary that nothing is impossible for God reflect the idea in Mark 9:23 that all things are possible for those who believe.
The doubt of Israel's people regarding God's ability to provide food in the wilderness challenges the power of faith, which is central in Mark 9:23.
